## Plugin reference

- Description: Per-row decisions chip on a conversation item: how many of its task's decisions need the user (one grouping of the Needs you tab by task, shared by every row). Nothing while zero.
- Web:
  - Contributes: `Item.Chips` → `DecisionsItemChip`
  - Uses:
    - `conversations/conversation-ui/item.Item`
    - `network/live.useLive`
    - `network/live/live-state.ResourceErrorInline`
    - `primitives/css/badge.Badge`
